notes: AOI [44.0, 160.0, -90.0, -60.0]: spherical centroid 102.0000, -78.8943; spans 116 x 30 degrees (~2487 x 3317 km, square, polar south); property conformal.
family: polar (south): stere on the pole. lon_0 only rotates a polar map (distortion is unchanged), so it is 0 as in EPSG:3031/3413-style grids; use 100 instead to put the AOI upright.
rounded to 10 degree steps (): max scale error 4.255% vs 4.255% exact; the coarsest step within 50% of exact, capped at 0.1 and floored at 0.01 percentage points.
EPSG:3976 (WGS 84 / NSIDC Sea Ice Polar Stereographic South) does as well over the AOI (3.943%), so the spec uses it.
domain: AOI's projected bounds padded 5% and snapped out to whole 512 px tiles at 1000 m; tile_px 512 keeps every tile edge a whole metre at [1000].
